title: Beer Steeped German Cheese Wrap
description: A German-inspired wrap filled with a rich beer-steeped cheese, served with a side of savory Dutch-style pickled vegetables.

ingredients.name: dutch-style pickling vegetables (such as carrots and onions)

instructions: Steep the beer in a saucepan over low heat for 10 minutes.
Add the german cheese to the beer saucepan and stir until melted.
Add the dutch-style pickling spices to the melted cheese and stir to combine.
Slice the dutch-style pickling vegetables into thin strips.
Add the sliced pickling vegetables to the melted cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Warm the japanese-style wrap in the microwave for 10 seconds.
Spoon the beer-steeped cheese mixture onto the warmed wrap.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
